annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei nº 897/2024 - Dispõe sobre a Autenticação de Mídia Digital criada ou modificada por Inteligência Artificial (IA) e dá outras providências
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 897/2024 - On the Authentication of Digital Media Created or Modified by Artificial Intelligence (AI)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Saullo Vianna, União/AM)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian Chamber of Deputies bill requiring clear, visible labelling and automated authentication of all digital media generated or modified by AI. Platforms must implement mechanisms ensuring authenticity, and competent bodies may enforce and sanction. Aims to counter disinformation. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Mandatory authentication of all AI-generated or AI-modified digital media
Clear and visible marking indicating origin and authenticity
Marking done through automated verification algorithms
Digital platforms responsible for mechanisms ensuring authenticity
Competent bodies may inspect and apply sanctions
